title: Morning Ritual
summary: Ada moves through the apartment in controlled amber light — bathroom, lamp, kettle, pour-over — and settles on the couch before the outside day can reach her.

narrative.newInfo: Ada's apartment and solo routine are rendered in detail — lived-in texture, self-sufficient rituals, the amber-lit interior she keeps as a buffer against the outside world.
narrative.dripHook: The precision and comfort of her routine makes the coming disruption easier to feel.
narrative.payoffDelivered: Atmosphere and relational reward: the reader inhabits Ada's self-made morning before any external pressure arrives.
narrative.beautyHooks: The chip on the mug rim turned away without thinking. The bathroom wedge of light that doesn't reach the rest of the apartment. The bloom darkening in the pour-over.
narrative.notes: Let the ritual carry the scene weight. No plot pressure yet — this beat earns trust through specificity and quiet.

rewardTokens.description: Amber lamp, kettle hiss, pour-over bloom — sensory texture that makes the apartment fully inhabitable.
Ada's quiet self-sufficiency and small unconscious habits deepen reader intimacy before any conflict arrives.

modelUpdate.before: Ada exists in her bedroom; the apartment is implied.
modelUpdate.shift: The apartment resolves into lived-in specificity through Ada's ritual movement through it.
modelUpdate.after: The reader understands Ada's baseline: precise, self-contained, comfortable in her own version of morning.
